music_prompt: Remix the uploaded FAZO Making History instrumental into intense male Southern sports-reporter RAP. Keep source tempo, key, chord loop, drums, bass and lead motif as closely as supported. Dense fluent basketball jargon and stats: flex/UCLA cuts, cross-screens, post seals, hedge/recover, assist-to-turnover, eFG and true shooting. Urgent courtside play-by-play: percussive bars, intelligible full names and numbers, tension, shouted BANG ad-libs and explosive final-horn emotion. All hooks/verses RAPPED, never sung. Full intro. Follow exact lyrics in order. The ENTIRE Jazz wins; all 14 season players credited, opponents named. Hudson/Cunningham are season credits only. Real stats anchor early rounds; the marked Game 6 fork and new Game 7 stats are alternate history. Exactly ONE featured 12-16-bar solo on the reference's main melodic lead instrument in the bridge; same rhythm section, no other featured solos. Resume rap for the shared-team title payoff.
lyrics:
[Intro - Urgent Sports-Reporter Rap]
Alternate history! Salt Lake, flip the tape!
Ninety-eight Jazz, one-seed, championship stakes!

[Hook - Rap]
BOX OUT! Chin the rebound! Outlet, GO!
Five on a string, make the next rotation!
Every screen, every stop, every second-chance score!
The whole Jazz did it! Hear the Delta Center ROAR!

[Verse 1 - Rap]
Sixty-two and twenty, home court through the bracket.
John Stockton, Karl Malone, pick-and-roll traffic.
Jerry Sloan's flex: cross-screen, duck-in, seal.
Howard Eisley probes, pocket pass, read and feel.
Jacque Vaughn ball pressure, turn the dribbler twice.
Troy Hudson, William Cunningham, wore the name.
Short stints before the playoffs, part of that year.
Every jersey gets its credit! Let the bench HEAR!
Houston Rockets, Hakeem Olajuwon's Dream Shake!
Clyde Drexler, Charles Barkley, no easy paint!
Down two-one! Elimination! No margin for error!
Shandon Anderson backcuts, punish wing pressure.
Game five, Greg Ostertag: SEVEN rejections!
Five in the fourth! That's rim protection!
Thirty-one, fifteen, five assists from Karl!
Eighty-four to seventy! Three-two! Next round!

[Verse 2 - Rap]
San Antonio Spurs: Tim Duncan, David Robinson.
Twin Towers! Hard hedge, recover, read the coverage.
Jeff Hornacek pin-down, curl into the seam.
Bryon Russell spots up, punish the double-team.
Adam Keefe cross-screens, Greg Foster seals.
Chris Morris on the wing, improve the entry feed.
Game four: seventeen for twenty-eight, no free throws!
Thirty-four, twelve boards! Face-up, elbow!
Game five, close four-one! Spurs, end of the road!
Los Angeles Lakers, Shaquille O'Neal down low.
Kobe Bryant, number eight; Eddie Jones on the wing.
Nick Van Exel probes; Jazz hedge, recover, swing.
Game four: thirty-two, fourteen off the glass!
Four-zero! Sweep! Nobody left out of the class!

[Hook - Rap]
BOX OUT! Chin the rebound! Outlet, GO!
Five on a string, make the next rotation!
Every screen, every stop, every second-chance score!
The whole Jazz did it! Hear the Delta Center ROAR!

[Verse 3 - Rap]
Chicago Bulls, Michael Jordan, triangle spacing.
Scottie Pippen denies; Dennis Rodman glass-chasing.
Pinch-post! Split cut! Midpost fadeaway!
Stockton twenty-four, game one, overtime W!
Bulls take three straight! Game three, fifty-four!
Empty trips! Dead silence! Sloan shuts the door!
Game five: Karl, thirty-nine, nine boards, five dimes!
Seventeen for twenty-seven! Season on the line!
Stockton twelve assists, five steals, reads the floor!
Antoine Carr, twelve off the bench! We need MORE!
Eighty-three, eighty-one! Back to Salt Lake!
One possession from the cliff! How much can they take?

[Bridge - Rap]
Game six: Stockton's triple, eighty-six, eighty-three!
Jordan layup! One-point lead! Don't expose the seam!
NOW CHANGE THE TIMELINE! Karl feels the weak-side dig!
Chin it! Pivot! Outlet! Secure it, don't get stripped!
Utah forces seven! Every teammate still in this!

[Instrumental Bridge - One Featured Main-Instrument Solo]

[Verse 4 - Alternate Game Seven Rap]
Our invented game seven! New box score, new stakes!
Malone thirty-two, fourteen, ten for eighteen!
Twelve of fourteen free throws! Those hands don't shake!
Sixty-six point two true shooting! PRESSURE BREAKS!
Stockton sixteen, fourteen dimes, two giveaways!
Seven-to-one assist-to-turnover! WHAT A GAME!
Hornacek eighteen, four triples, bury the help!
Eighty percent E-F-G! Listen to that bench YELL!
Russell denies! Ostertag contests! Secure the board!
Ninety-six, ninety-two! FOUR-THREE! HORN!
Finals MVP to Karl, points to EVERY JERSEY!
Tears in the huddle! The whole squad earned it!
Rings come later! Tonight, hold that trophy high!
Utah Jazz together! Bench to starters, this is WHY!

[Final Hook - Rap]
Rockets! Spurs! Lakers! Bulls! Count every round!
Every Jazz jersey, champions! Raise that sound!
BOX OUT! Last horn! Whole team on the floor!
Utah wins this timeline! Hear the Delta Center ROAR!
